contract.gatePair: Reciprocal partner IDs; invalid pairs are ignored together.
contract.gateRadius: 10..40, default18; ball center crosses the rim.
contract.exit: Partner center plus rotated unit velocity times partner radius +5.5+.1.
contract.trace: Exit points have move:true; travel across the board is discontinuous.
contract.starRule: Three stars when shots spent <=par; two <=par+1; one otherwise. Meadow par remains1.

results.name: Meadow defaults retain three volleys, three balls, steering, bursts, lifetime, and star ratings
Moon fires exactly one centered seed and consumes one of five shots
Disabled guidance remains a no-op and cannot alter velocity or gain charge
Twelve blooms may celebrate but do not automatically spawn balls when disabled
Configured seven-second lifetime ends each shot and the fifth miss ends the level once
Moon stars use shots spent against par rather than the five-shot allowance
Swept collision selects the nearest gate rim but honors an earlier solid hit
A fast gate crossing rotates velocity, preserves speed, clears trail, and emits one located event
Remaining travel after teleport can hit and reflect from a flower in the same physics tick
Cooldown blocks immediate passage and each ball has a bounded lifetime hop budget
Repeated portal and wall travel remains finite, bounded, and eventually ends
Malformed, ambiguous, self-paired, unpaired, and unsafe gates are ignored as complete pairs
Trace has an explicit gate discontinuity and agrees with the centered live shot target
Gate trajectories, event counts, and scoring are identical at 30, 60, and 144 FPS
Malformed optional rules normalize to safe bounded values
